functionalReqs: Multiple floors with spots of different types (bike, compact, large, EV)
Assign the nearest suitable free spot when a vehicle enters; issue a ticket
Compute the fee on exit (hourly rates per vehicle type)
Show free spots per floor and type
hints: List the nouns: ParkingLot, Floor, Spot, Vehicle, Ticket, Gate, Payment. Which are abstract?
Make spot selection and fee calculation pluggable strategies.

ParkingLot (singleton or injected) has Floors; Floor has Spots by type; SpotAssignmentStrategy (nearest-first) and PricingStrategy interfaces; VehicleFactory; synchronise assignment per spot type (lock or atomic free list) for concurrent gates.
nonFunctionalReqs: Two gates must not assign the same spot
New vehicle types and pricing rules without changing existing classes
problemStatement:
Design the classes for a **multi-floor parking lot**. Vehicles of different sizes enter, get a suitable spot and a ticket, and pay on exit based on time parked.

The design should make it easy to add new vehicle types, spot types and pricing rules.
title: Design a Parking Lot
